description: LiteLLM Proxy embeddings, traced by the proxy's otel callback.
notes: The proxy runs as a subprocess with callbacks: [otel] and message logging left on; only the embedding model is routed, to the mock (FAKE_BASE), with the local model cost map and OTLP/HTTP protobuf export to the receiver. One embeddings.create reaches the upstream as text-embedding-3-small. gen_ai.operation.name is aembedding and gen_ai.system is empty, so the span has no provider; the proxy reports no cost keys on embeddings, so the price comes from the built-in table by model name. gen_ai.response.id is a UUID per run. span_names keeps the litellm_request span and drops the plumbing spans and the health-probe trace. litellm.call_id, hidden_params, metadata.requester_metadata and metadata.requester_ip_address are volatile for the same reasons as the chat case.
